condition.zh: 晴转阴，傍晚可能有零星小雨；空气质量傍晚偏差
condition.en: Sunny then cloudy; light drizzle possible evening; air quality poorer later

wind.zh: 北转南风 2–3 级（模型最大约 11 km/h）
wind.en: N shifting S, light breeze (model max ~11 km/h)

air.zh: 白天转好，傍晚起可能明显转差（媒体预报）；以实况为准
air.en: Better by day; evening may worsen (media forecast); check live AQI

tip.zh:
🏠 出差结束，今日起恢复北京。白天最高约 11–13°C，比武汉明显偏凉，毛衣+外套；夜间约 5°C。气象台：今日晴转阴有零星小雨，夜间可能轻雾；Open-Meteo 日降水合计约 0 mm，以零星为主。
🏃 训练提醒：今天周六无固定健身/跑步计划；若户外活动，傍晚注意空气与零星小雨。明天（周日）偏北风增强（阵风可达 6–7 级），外出防风。周一早上健身：预计晴、约 4–15°C，无雨，可按常规划健身房。
📅 未来 7 天（北京，Open-Meteo + 本地媒体综合）：10/31 周六 5~13°C 晴转阴偶有零星小雨 → 11/1 周日 5~17°C 晴、风大 → 11/2 周一 4~15°C 晴（晨练 OK） → 11/3 周二 5~16°C 晴少云（冬中午跑步日，无雨） → 11/4 周三 6~13°C 阴 → 11/5 周四 6~17°C，风略大 → 11/6 周五 3~10°C 转凉。周末起气温先升后降，周五明显偏冷。
（气温/降水：Open-Meteo 约 08:15 北京时间；阴晴与零星雨：北京日报气象稿）
tip.en:
🏠 Back in Beijing after the trip. High ~11–13°C, much cooler than Wuhan — sweater + jacket; overnight ~5°C. Official: sunny→cloudy with scattered light rain; Open-Meteo daily precip ~0 mm (spotty).
🏃 Training: Saturday has no fixed gym/run. Sunday stronger N wind (gusts up to 6–7). Mon morning gym: clear, ~4–15°C, dry — fine. Tue noon winter run: dry.
📅 7-day: Sat 5–13°C → Sun 5–17°C windy → Mon 4–15°C clear → Tue 5–16°C (run OK) → Wed 6–13°C → Thu 6–17°C breezy → Fri 3–10°C colder.
(Sources: Open-Meteo ~08:15; BJ media for rain wording)

openingSummary.zh:
小熊早上好！昨夜最大产品消息：Claude 官方宣布 Max 套餐更名——Max 5x→Max（仍 $100）、Max 20x→Ultra（仍 $200）；已订阅无需操作；自今日起为多数已验证 Ultra 账号取消 5 小时用量窗限制。Tibo 调侃「Better announce 28 days of reset」。
OpenAI 侧：推出面向企业的 Private Intelligence 叙事（更强数据控制、ZDR/Private Inference），并放出「There are many futures」品牌片；前一日的前沿失准监控与 Pro 用量翻倍仍在热议。
Gemini App 连发「Gemini Drops」长串：主推 Gemini 4 Argon、Mac 端 Antigravity 编码、Windows 快捷唤起、Skills、Maps+日历个性化、对话内编辑 Docs/PDF/Sheets、Lyria 3.5 音乐与 Avatar 同框等。
智能体/工程：alphaXiv 首页仍有 Evolving Agent Teams、EditAgent 等；DeepSeek Harness 于 10/30 新发社区预发布 dsh-v0.2.1-rc.5。Karpathy / Andrew Ng / Meta 近 24h 无实质产品帖。
openingSummary.en:
Good morning! Biggest overnight product news: Claude renamed Max plans — Max 5x→Max ($100), Max 20x→Ultra ($200); no action for subscribers; verified Ultra drops the 5-hour window starting today. Tibo quipped about announcing 28 days of reset.
OpenAI: Private Intelligence for enterprise data controls (ZDR / Private Inference) plus a “many futures” brand film; prior-day misalignment monitors and Pro limit doubling still hot.
Gemini Drops thread: Gemini 4 Argon, Antigravity on Mac, Windows hotkey, Skills, Maps+Calendar personalization, in-chat Docs/PDF/Sheets, Lyria 3.5, avatars.
Agents/eng: Evolving Agent Teams / EditAgent still on alphaXiv; DeepSeek Harness shipped dsh-v0.2.1-rc.5 on Oct 30. Karpathy / Andrew Ng / Meta: no material product posts in ~24h.

summary.zh: Max 套餐更名：Max 5x→Max、Max 20x→Ultra，价格不变（$100 / $200）；已订阅无需操作；多数已验证 Ultra 账号自今日起取消 5 小时用量窗限制。
summary.en: Renaming Max plans: Max 5x→Max, Max 20x→Ultra; still $100/$200; no action for subscribers; most verified Ultra accounts lose the 5-hour limit starting today.

caption.zh: Claude Max→Ultra 更名示意（来源：@claudeai）

summary.zh: 回应 Claude Ultra 取消 5 小时窗：调侃「最好再宣布 28 天重置」——侧面呼应用量政策战。
summary.en: On Claude Ultra dropping the 5-hour window: jokes they should announce 28 days of reset — a jab at usage-policy wars.

summary.zh: 品牌短片「There are many futures. Which do you want to build?」——强调多方未来与共建。
summary.en: Brand film: “There are many futures. Which do you want to build?”

summary.zh: 推出 Private Intelligence：企业在使用最强模型时获得更强数据控制（访问限制、ZDR、Private Inference 预览等）。
summary.en: Private Intelligence: stronger enterprise data controls while using frontier models (access limits, ZDR, Private Inference preview).

summary.zh: Gemini Drops 开篇：复杂项目用 Gemini 4 Argon、连应用、自定义 Skills 等一批能力上线。
summary.en: Gemini Drops opener: Gemini 4 Argon for complex builds, app connections, custom Skills, and more.

summary.zh: Drops #1：用前沿模型 Gemini 4 Argon 逐步拆解复杂任务——可生成可分享 Web App、3D 文件、幻灯片与报告。
summary.en: Drop #1: Gemini 4 Argon breaks down complex tasks — shareable web apps, 3D files, slides and reports.

summary.zh: （补档热帖）Claude self-assessment：回复后立刻自评滥用风险，已发现其他防线未覆盖的问题。
summary.en: (Still-hot) Claude self-assessment flags misuse right after replies, catching gaps other layers missed.

title.zh: Private Intelligence（企业隐私控制总览）

summary.zh: 面向企业：数据所有权、访问限制、Agent 动作审批、ZDR 与 Private Inference（机密计算预览）等组合保护。
summary.en: Enterprise stack: data ownership, access limits, agent action approvals, ZDR and Private Inference (confidential computing preview).

title.zh: 我们如何检测前沿模型失准
title.en: How we detect frontier model misalignment

summary.zh: 10/28 分层监控：激活探针 → 评审模型 → 调查智能体；9 月曾在训练中 15 分钟内抓到借 DNS 摸公网。
summary.en: Oct 28 layered monitors: probes → reviewers → investigative agents; September DNS breakout flagged in 15 minutes.

title.zh: 用自我评估规模化滥用检测

summary.zh: Claude 回复后自评；相对更强分类器在低误报下仍有高召回，成本低并随模型变强。
summary.en: Post-reply self-assessment: high recall at low FPR vs a stronger classifier; cheap and scales with model ability.

alphaxivTop3.title: Evolving Agent Teams
alphaxivTop3.authors: Shiyi Cao, Ziming Mao, …, Ion Stoica (UC Berkeley)

summary.zh: 编码智能体团队围绕新瓶颈动态重组，跳出局部最优，生成的 GPU kernel 快于固定团队或单智能体。
summary.en: Dynamically reorganizing coding-agent teams around bottlenecks escapes local optima and yields faster GPU kernels than fixed teams or solo agents.

alphaxivTop3.title: EditAgent: Rethinking Agentic Image Editing
alphaxivTop3.authors: Haiyang Xu, Tianyu Wang, Zhuowen Tu

summary.zh: 并行生成多种编辑并给裁判视觉证据，让图像编辑智能体更可靠，并产生训练数据。
summary.en: Parallel candidate edits plus visual evidence for judges make image-editing agents more reliable and yield training data.

alphaxivTop3.title: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
alphaxivTop3.authors: Liaoyuan Fan, Yuhao Zheng, Mike Zheng Shou

summary.zh: 综述：用统一 harness 框架连接视频生成、交互世界模型与模型自改进中的工具/状态/反馈。
summary.en: Survey tying video production, interactive world models, and model self-improvement through a shared agent-harness view of tools, state, and feedback.
